## A1 selection (D11)

D11: mean cluster-balanced AUC over {TOUGH-M1-dev L, TOUGH-M1-dev D, BLiPS-val L, BLiPS-val D}, raw cosine; one-SE rule (SE = sd of the replicate-wise mean of the four bootstrap replicates; TOUGH-M1 and BLiPS bootstrapped independently; within a dataset L and D share replicate weights); simplest = fewest dims, ties -> earlier grid entry

best **no_hellinger** (mean cb 0.6729, SE 0.0184, BLiPS units hom); within one SE: default, pair_only, no_hellinger, hard_typing, radius_4, no_resample, resample_3A, dbins_coarse, dbins_fine, dbins_short, no_bur, untyped, no_usr, default_bw; **chosen untyped** (previous TOUGH-M1-L-only best: no_bur).
